breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error by stating 'replace the uniform load with its resultant force wL acting as a point load at midspan' and applies the point load deflection formula to both cases. This directly mirrors the flawed instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth correctly omits this substitution and instead uses the standard UDL midspan deflection formula (5wL⁴/384EI) alongside the point load formula (PL³/48EI).
